notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers twice and Cloudstone Curio triggers once.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the first Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake token's trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
